chunks: He said: Abu Ubaidullah Muhammad ibn Umar al-Marzbani reported to me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Jawhari, who reported from al-Hasan ibn Ulail al-Anzi, from Abdul Karim ibn Muhammad, who reported from Hamza ibn al-Qasim al-Alawi, who reported from Abdul Azeem ibn Abdillah al-Alawi, from al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn al-Arani, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, that al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, said:

Ummu Salama, may Allah bless her with mercy, once woke up weeping. She was asked: "What makes you cry?" She said: "My son al-Husayn, peace be upon him, has been killed last night. And that is because I have never seen the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family, in a dream since he passed away until last night. I saw him pale and in profound grief."
She said: "So I asked: 'Why do I see you pale and grieving, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'I have been digging graves for al-Husayn and his companions tonight, peace be upon them.'"

key_terms.أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ: Ummu Salama, wife of Prophet Muhammad
key_terms.نَعْيُ الْحُسَيْنِ: news of the martyrdom of al-Husayn

ai.seo_question: What did Ummu Salama dream about the Prophet regarding al-Husayn's martyrdom?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq narrates that Ummu Salama, the Prophet's wife, woke up weeping one morning, declaring that al-Husayn had been killed. She explained that she saw the Prophet in a dream for the first time since his death, appearing pale and sorrowful, saying he had been digging graves for al-Husayn and his companions all night. This hadith establishes the spiritual connection between the Prophet and the tragedy of Karbala.
word_analysis: may Allah have mercy on her
